title: Browser-side FIPS mesh read-model store
intent: Expose FIPS mesh nodes and DNS/FIPS endpoints to the web UI from Nostr read-model events only.
observed_repository_evidence: internal/adapters/nostr/projector.go publishes DNSEndpointState as kind 31976 with family, dns, addr, health, npub, worker, and mesh=fips tags for worker-backed endpoints.
internal/domain/dns.go defines DNSEndpoint fields consumed by the browser store, including family, source, metadata, health, drift status, FQDN, address, and worker pubkey.
internal/domain/worker.go defines FIPSOverlayAddr, FIPSEndpoints, and MeshHealth on Worker.
web/src/lib/nostr/client.js provides EOSE-authoritative queryUntilEose and live subscribe callbacks.
implemented_behavior: web/src/lib/stores/fips-mesh.svelte.js bootstraps mesh endpoint and worker state read models via nostr.queryUntilEose, then keeps a live nostr.subscribe open.
Filters scope DNSEndpointState reads by kind 31976, #family mesh/worker, and #mesh fips; worker state reads use kind 32000 with service author scoping when available.
The store dedupes replaceable read-model events by kind, author, and d tag through the Nostr client replaceable helper, removes tombstoned records, and ignores non-mesh DNS endpoint state.
The exported state includes mesh nodes, mesh endpoints, health classification, overlay address, pubkey/npub, transport endpoints, DNS hostname, projection status, and gating reason fields.
out_of_scope: DNS/operator page wiring is reserved for bahia-wprt.
No REST endpoint was added for FIPS mesh state.
